text:
olivia: heads-up — eu-edge showing memory spike after the latest serializer push. 503s on embeddings path. Need a hotfix deploy ASAP, requesting expedited approval to bypass full canary and pin v2.3.3 as fallback.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] detected service degradation in cluster eu-west1.
- affected: embeddings-service
- symptom: OOM on worker pods (10-15% error rate)
- current release: v2.3.4-serializer
- rollback candidate: v2.3.3

sam: on it. can you paste the failing stack or logs?

olivia: logs show serializer allocate spike when handling long-context batched requests. snippet:```
E 14:02:11 serializer.cpp:472 allocate failed: requested 1.2GB, available 128MB
W 14:02:12 fallback to disk cache
```

tasha: quick question — are we sure it's v2.3.4 change? telemetry shows a small bump coincident with deploy.

olivia: correlates with deploy timestamp 14:00 UTC. other infra looks healthy.

mike-oncall: I'm on-call and +1 for expedited action. If we can pin to v2.3.3 and shift traffic, we should. Need two approvers for canary-skip per policy.

anne-ops: +1 from ops assuming we do a pin (no database schema changes). Confirming: pin = immediate rollback to v2.3.3 and hold traffic until patch?

leo: i'll take the rollout. Plan: revert to v2.3.3 (pin), drain new pods, scale old replica sets, watch for errors, then hold for 30m. If stable, we open a postmortem and push a patched v2.3.5 later.

sam: approve — i'm owning the patch afterwards to fix allocation path.

olivia: approve from product/impact side. expedited approvals: mike-oncall, anne-ops, sam, olivia => enough?

mike-oncall: yep that's 3+ approvers. Deploybot override request: `deploy-bot override --thread 1803334444 --skip-canary`

deploy-bot: Executing pin workflow...
```
$ kubectl rollout undo deploy/embeddings-service --to-revision=rev-2.3.3
Scaling replicaset rs-v2.3.3 -> 6
Draining rs-v2.3.4
Waiting for pods to become ready
```

deploy-bot: Rollback started by olivia (expedited). Expected user-visible recovery in ~3m. Monitoring: error-rate, p95 latency, memory-usage.

leo: Started draining v2.3.4 pods. Will post status every 30s.

(30s) leo: 2/6 v2.3.3 pods ready, error-rate down from 12% -> 6%.

(90s) leo: 5/6 ready, memory usage stable, embeddings 200ms p95.

(3m) deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Services reporting nominal. Error-rate back to baseline ~0.3%.

anne-ops: Confirming service health. Ops verifies: no regression on other routes.

mike-oncall: official approve to keep pinned for now. We'll schedule patch deployment in 2-hour maintenance window if tests pass.

olivia: thanks all — i will file release-note entry and tag the incident. Sam, ping when the patch PR is ready and we'll coordinate canary with automated smoke. :thumbsup:

sam: will do, targeting PR + CI by end of the hour.

leo: closing thread after monitoring window. If anything flares, we reopen.
